note: Human-set, versioned failure-mode taxonomy. A protected input resource: Reflect may summarise over it and must cite ids from it, but may not add, rename or redefine an id. Every revision record names (failure_mode, taxonomy_version) so that 'the same failure class' is machine-decidable — which is what the transfer-replay arm of the capability claim rests on. Changing this file is a human act and starts taxonomy v2.

chemistry.note: Assigned by scripts/reflect/failure_digest.py::classify from the recorded attempt, never by a model. scripts/qa/test_failure_taxonomy.py asserts the classifier emits nothing outside this table.

ok.meaning: The attempt met the endpoint criterion; not a failure.

ts_not_converged.meaning: OptTS never landed on a saddle.
ts_not_converged.implicates: guess geometry or scan coordinate, not the mechanism

multiple_imaginary.meaning: More than one imaginary mode beyond the contaminant threshold.
multiple_imaginary.implicates: soft-mode cleanup: displace along the mode and reoptimise

no_dominant_mode.meaning: Only soft modes; a floppy minimum rather than a saddle.
no_dominant_mode.implicates: the guess did not cross the reaction coordinate

no_endpoint_record.meaning: No IRC endpoint record: the run never reached IRC, or the record is missing.
no_endpoint_record.implicates: driver or IRC settings, not the mechanism

both_ends_reactant.meaning: Both IRC ends optimise to the reactant.
both_ends_reactant.implicates: the saddle sits on the wrong side of the intended barrier

both_ends_product.meaning: Both IRC ends optimise to the product.

one_end_only.meaning: One end matches, the other wanders.
one_end_only.implicates: coordinate direction roughly right; the other end needs pre-organisation or a tighter constraint

no_match.meaning: Neither end is a target species.
no_match.implicates: the saddle connects a pair nobody asked for; the mechanistic hypothesis may not hold

wall_time.meaning: Abandoned on the per-guess wall clock before a verdict could be reached.
wall_time.implicates: cost, not chemistry; carries no evidence about the step

mass_unbalanced.meaning: Refused before any calculation: reactant atoms do not equal product plus coproduct.
mass_unbalanced.implicates: the proposal itself; no IRC could connect the stated endpoints

process.note: Failures of the machinery rather than of a chemical hypothesis. A revision attributed to one of these is `plumbing` class and supports no capability claim.

tool_crash_reported_as_result.meaning: A tool failed to run and its output was recorded as a chemical negative.
tool_crash_reported_as_result.implicates: the tool must fail loudly; a crash is not evidence

stale_path_reference.meaning: A documented or hard-coded path does not exist in this repository.

path_alias.meaning: A written path used an alias the filesystem does not have.

low_candidate_yield.meaning: Explore produced too few admissible candidates to keep validation busy.
low_candidate_yield.implicates: the candidate source, not the bar

near_duplicate_spend.meaning: Budget went to candidates that are near-duplicates of what was already explored.
